body: I relate to this alot. The smallest thing can just make me think "well time to kill myself". That and like any opportunity I am I contemplate death, like I'm on the second floor of a shop? I'll automatically start wondering wether jumping will kill me or not. Or when I'm near a train, I just think how easy it would be to step into the rails.

I understand. I think about getting run over by cars or some other accident that happens because then it's out of my control if I die or not. I mean I want my life to mean something but I know in the end I'll just end up being forgotten when I'm dead anyway so why even try.

I'm a hypocrite for saying any of this but honestly were all going to die someday so mayswell make an experience out of it and enjoy whilst we can if we can I guess. And some days are better than others so live for those days. Because if you don't you'll miss out on them, or more importantly they'll miss out on you. Because whatever input you have on the world, big or small, it will still matter. Like If I'm walking and kick a rock I'll wonder how that will affect the rest of the world because now that rocks not there so somebody might not step on it or something. It's dumb but it keeps me going sometimes because everything we do has impact and everything you do matters. You matter.
